P01.rationale: No founder or person portrait appears anywhere on the page; the layout is entirely text and data graphics.

P05.rationale: There are no case study sections or client portraits present on this page.

P07.rationale: No press logo wall, rating cards, review grid, or testimonial apparatus is present; the quote block is a pull-quote, not a social-proof structure.

P10.rationale: A large opening quotation mark glyph appears in the pull-quote block at the bottom, but no giant ghost numerals or other oversized decorative typographic elements are used.

P11.rationale: Three partial donut/ring charts are shown with real percentage figures (30%, 60%, 30-50%) and source citations, but they are simple icon-level graphics rather than full data visualisations with before/after or cost-math breakdowns.

P12.rationale: The upper half is reasonably filled with a two-column text block, but a large dead zone exists between the data graphics and the pull-quote, leaving the page feeling under-filled overall.

P13.rationale: A subtle warm off-white/cream paper texture is applied to the background, providing a mild atmospheric quality rather than flat white, though it is very understated.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The page contains no photography at all, only abstract ring charts and text, so there is minimal risk of generic stock imagery, though the charts themselves are generic in style.

N08.rationale: A notably large empty region exists in the middle of the page between the data-stat section and the pull-quote block, representing significant purposeless dead whitespace.

N10.rationale: No text is placed over a busy photo; all text sits on the clean background or within the clearly delineated pull-quote box.
